mapper.insert: INSERT INTO miss_you (couple_code, user_id, nickname, miss_date, count, create_time) VALUES (#{coupleCode}, #{userId}, #{nickname}, #{missDate}, #{count}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE miss_you SET count = count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND miss_date = #{missDate}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM miss_you WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND miss_date = #{missDate}
SELECT * FROM miss_you WHERE couple_code = #{coupleCode} AND miss_date = #{missDate} ORDER BY user_id
